coverage_assessment: Bounded open-web first pass: 37 queries in English, French, German and Luxembourgish, including weekly windows, local coverage, HORECA, official records, adjacent-month and rights/police searches. 22 exact-URL source cards (9 opened, 11 search_only, 2 blocked). Several full pages were unavailable; judgment text was cached while later ordinary HTTPS attempts returned 404; Le Quotidien was read by the coordinator via normal HTTPS. No LexisNexis/systematic archive, no completeness claim, and no independent corroboration implied by source count. Six January event candidates, two announcement exclusions, no established continuations; source and threshold gaps remain for review.
